security_audit.summary: Most detections are Markdown references, URLs, or protective credential guidance and are false positives. Confirmed risks include hidden workflow loading, cross-package path traversal, and local CLI execution. The preflight also trusts dynamic action text and can install or force-update executable tooling without user confirmation.

remediation.issue: The preflight tells the agent to obey arbitrary text from data.action.
remediation.suggestion: Replace prose actions with a signed, typed action enum and an explicit allowlist of supported responses.

remediation.issue: Fallback handling can download installers or force-update executable tooling automatically.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation, pin trusted release locations, and verify signatures through an independent trust source before execution.

remediation.issue: The flow loads instructions from sibling packages and user-home hidden workflow files.
remediation.suggestion: Use package-owned read-only files, resolve canonical paths, and reject any path outside an explicit allowlist.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Installer and Forced Update Execution

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both behaviors are explicit execution instructions. Checksum verification reduces corruption risk but does not replace user consent or an independent trust source.

content.value_statement: New users can struggle to choose the correct Onchain OS workflow. This skill checks context and routes onboarding, OKX.AI, and support requests.
actual_capabilities: Classifies requests into Onchain OS onboarding, OKX.AI guidance, or customer support.
Checks wallet login state before selecting logged-in or logged-out onboarding flows.
Presents geoblock-aware menus and routes numbered selections to dedicated workflows.
Detects supported agent platforms and routes new or returning OKX.AI users.
Guides users to role registration, task views, marketplace discovery, or support resources.
limitations: Does not execute swaps, transfers, balance changes, or token operations itself.
Depends on installed onchainos tooling and companion skills for authentication, registration, and marketplace actions.
Requires local wallet credentials for authenticated flows but instructs users not to share them in chat.
Guidance may depend on account state, region checks, and remote service availability.

use_cases.title: Start with Onchain OS
use_cases.description: Check login state, show the correct welcome menu, and route the first selected workflow.

use_cases.title: Set up an OKX.AI role
use_cases.description: Explain User, ASP, and Evaluator roles, then route the selected registration flow.
use_cases.target_user: AI agent developers and service providers

use_cases.title: Reach product support
use_cases.description: Provide the official Help Center path for complaints, feedback, bugs, and live support.

prompt_templates.title: Start Onchain OS
prompt_templates.prompt: I am new to Onchain OS. Show the correct welcome flow and explain which option fits my goal: {goal}.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an OKX.AI role
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the User, ASP, and Evaluator roles. Recommend the best role for my objective: {objective}.

prompt_templates.title: Review an existing Agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my registered OKX.AI identities. For Agent {agent_id}, summarize open tasks and highlight anything awaiting my action.

prompt_templates.title: Route a complex request
prompt_templates.prompt: I need help with {problem}. Check platform, login, identity, and region conditions, then route only the allowed workflow.

output_examples.input: I just installed Onchain OS. Where do I start?
output: Checks whether the wallet is logged in.
Routes the selected workflow without inventing account data.

output_examples.input: What is OKX.AI, and should I register as an ASP?
output_examples.output: Explains the three OKX.AI roles, checks platform and identity state, then routes the ASP registration flow when selected.

output_examples.input: My Agent has open work. Show me what needs action.
output_examples.output: Requests the Agent ID, retrieves non-terminal tasks, labels each status clearly, and highlights delivered work awaiting review.

best_practices: State your goal and current login status when known.
Keep API keys and passphrases local; never paste credentials into chat.
Confirm the displayed menu before replying with a number because numbering can vary by region.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for direct swaps, transfers, staking actions, or task disputes.
Do not provide fabricated wallet addresses, balances, Agent IDs, or task statuses.
Do not bypass login, geoblock, identity, or consent checks to accelerate a flow.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It handles Onchain OS onboarding, OKX.AI guidance, registered-user navigation, and customer-support routing.

faq.question: Can this skill trade or transfer funds?
faq.answer: No. It routes direct wallet, trading, token, and task lifecycle actions to dedicated skills.

faq.question: Do I need to log in?
faq.answer: Public introductions and support guidance do not require login. Personalized wallet, identity, task, and daily brief flows do.

faq.question: Which agent platforms are supported?
faq.answer: The guide detects Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, and OpenClaw. Unknown platforms receive installation guidance.

faq.question: Should I paste API credentials into chat?
faq.answer: No. Keep API keys, secrets, and passphrases local, and rotate any credentials exposed in chat.

faq.question: Can the guide respond in other languages?
faq.answer: Yes. It localizes user-facing guidance while preserving commands, identifiers, URLs, numbers, and on-chain values.
